summary: Streaming session stalls mid-generation then abrupt connection close after model fallback to quantized variant
description: Issue summary: Multiple streaming chat sessions for FinBank using SSE/WebSocket stop emitting tokens mid-generation for responses longer than ~3s, then the connection is reset with a TCP RST or 502 returned to the client. Impact: Customer-facing chat experiences drop messages and the FinBank mobile app shows repeated 'generation failed' errors for ~5% of long responses. Environment: prod, us-east, enterprise tenancy on dedicated pool with autoscaling and model fallback enabled. Observed behavior: 1) Request starts and initial tokens stream normally. 2) After a latency spike (token emission pause ~4-7s) the server stops sending further chunks. 3) Within 10-20s the connection is closed abruptly. Expected behavior: continuous token streaming until generation completes or graceful error with structured error message and retryable code.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Using FinBank enterprise API key, start a streaming chat request with system prompt and a long assistant completion target (>300 tokens).
2) Force model fallback by simultaneously issuing a heavier non-streaming job to saturate the fp16 pool (we reproduced by running a 50-token batch on redwood-open-13b-fp16).
3) Observe token output for the streaming session; when worker fallback to quantized variant occurs we saw stalls and eventual connection reset.
4) Repeat under prod us-east with autoscaler min_capacity set to 2 and max_burst enabled to see consistent repro.
logs: Request trace: trace_id=trc_20260310_5f7a2 - initial chunks at 2026-03-10T14:12:03Z then no emit after 14:12:07Z until RST at 14:12:25Z.
Serving runtime stderr: 'kv_cache_eviction: worker_preempted during in-flight request', repeated at 14:12:08Z.
API gateway: upstream keepalive closed by peer after 17s idle - see logs s3://redwood-ops/logs/finbank/2026-03-10/streaming/trace_trc_20260310_5f7a2.log
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 15:00 - Support: Confirmed reproducible under load using FinBank's tenant key. Initial hypothesis: autoscaler or scheduler preempting quantized worker leading to abrupt KV cache loss and no graceful handoff.

2026-03-11 09:20 - Infra: Observed spike in tail latencies coinciding with model fallback events; the runtime issued 'worker_preempt' due to CPU watchdog triggered by a GC/compaction loop when quantized kernels loaded.

2026-03-11 11:45 - Eng: Found missing keepalive refresh for SSE sessions when a worker migrates requests to fallback instances; API gateway keeps connection open but upstream TCP reset occurs if backend process exits without flushing stream.
2026-03-11 14:30 - Repro attempt: Disabled fallback (pin to fp16) reduced incidents to <0.1% in short-run test, suggesting fallback path is correlated with failures.

Current hypothesis: Combination of (1) quantized model fallback path that loads kernels synchronously causing a short JVM/native pause, (2) autoscaler preemption policy that kills idle workers aggressively, and (3) missing SSE keepalive/flush on worker termination -> results in mid-generation silence and abrupt close.
comments: 2026-03-10 15:12 - Aisha Patel (Support): 'Customer reports ~5% failure rate for long responses after recent config change to enable q4 fallback for cost savings. Customer impact high since sessions are customer-facing.'

2026-03-11 09:35 - Diego Ramos (Infra): 'I can reproduce locally by toggling fallback; attaching a script and logs to the ticket. Looks like kernel load blocks event loop for ~300-500ms repeatedly then a later preempt kills the worker.'

2026-03-11 12:10 - Priya Singh (SRE): 'Temporarily bumped autoscaler preemption timeout from 30s to 90s for FinBank dedicated pool; incidents stopped in canary. Need a permanent fix in serving-runtime to stream heartbeat before termination.'

2026-03-11 16:00 - Liam O'Connor (Assignee): 'Opened PR to add graceful drain/flush on worker shutdown and to make quantized kernel loads async: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1872. Scheduling canary deploy tomorrow.'
resolution: Workaround applied: increased autoscaler preemption timeout for FinBank dedicated pool and disabled automatic q4 fallback for their tenancy; implemented keepalive/flush in API gateway to reduce abrupt closes. Fix PR opened to serving-runtime to perform asynchronous kernel load and graceful worker drain (PR 1872). Plan: canary deploy patched runtime 2026-03-13, monitor for 72h, then roll to prod if stable.
